s0201.literal: The five guard armies and newly submitted troops were dispatched to dredge the Mengcun canal.
s0201.idiomatic: The five guard armies and newly submitted troops were sent to dredge the canal at Mengcun.

s0202.literal: On gengchen day the Bieshili courier relay was established.
s0202.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Bieshili courier relay was established.

s0203.literal: The Song suburban altar terrace was demolished.
s0203.idiomatic: The Song suburban altar terrace was demolished.

s0204.literal: Sangge said: "Yang Lianzhenjia says that in Kuaiji there is Taining Monastery; the Song demolished it to build the temporary mausoleum for Emperor Ningzong and others;
s0204.idiomatic: Sangge said, "Yang Lianzhenjia says that Kuaiji has Taining Monastery, which the Song demolished to build the temporary mausoleum for Emperor Ningzong and others;

s0205.literal: Qiantang has Longhua Monastery; the Song demolished it for the southern suburban altar.
s0205.idiomatic: Qiantang has Longhua Monastery, which the Song demolished for the southern suburban altar.

s0206.literal: Both are fine sites and should be restored as monasteries to pray for long life for the Emperor and the Eastern Palace.
s0206.idiomatic: Both are fine sites and should be restored as monasteries to pray for the long life of the Emperor and the heir apparent.

s0207.literal: " At this time the temporary mausoleum for Ningzong and others had already been demolished and a monastery built; an edict ordered the suburban altar terrace demolished and a monastery built there as well.
s0207.idiomatic: " By then the temporary mausoleum for Ningzong and others had already been demolished and a monastery built; an edict ordered the suburban altar terrace demolished and a monastery built there as well.

s0208.literal: On renwu day an edict ordered establishment of the Maritime Trade General Transport Bureau.
s0208.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict established the maritime trade general transport bureau.

s0209.literal: The Shangdu and other routes Pasture General Transport Commission and the Various Routes Ever-Normal Salt, Iron, Mining, and Smelting General Transport Commission were established.
s0209.idiomatic: The Shangdu and other routes pasture general transport commission and the various routes ever-normal salt, iron, mining, and smelting general transport commission were established.

s0210.literal: On jiashen day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice on the Emperor's behalf at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar.
s0210.idiomatic: On jiashen day envoys were sent to sacrifice at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Streams, Eastern Sea, and Earth Altar in the Emperor's stead.

s0211.literal: On wuzi day Kuoniyadun said: "There was an earlier order to dispatch two thousand troops to garrison-farm at Shaobo Pond; testing the soil's fertility and barrenness, last autumn more than twenty thousand shi of rice were harvested; I ask to add two thousand garrison-farming soldiers.
s0211.idiomatic: On wuzi day Kuoniyadun said, "An earlier order had dispatched 2,000 troops to garrison-farm at Shaobo Pond; after testing the soil's fertility, last autumn more than 20,000 shi of rice were harvested; I ask to add 2,000 garrison-farming soldiers.

s0213.literal: Eight hundred Jiangnan musicians were moved to the capital.
s0213.idiomatic: 800 Jiangnan musicians were moved to the capital.

s0214.literal: The imperial son-in-law Suolangge was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningchang Commandery and granted a silver seal with tortoise knob.
s0214.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Suolangge was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningchang Commandery and granted a silver seal with tortoise knob.

s0215.literal: In West Sichuan the monk Zhao claimed to be Prince Guang, son of Song Emperor Fuzong, to deceive the people, and some believed him;
s0215.idiomatic: In West Sichuan a monk Zhao claimed to be Prince Guang, son of Song Emperor Fuzong, to deceive the people, and some believed him;

s0216.literal: In Zhending a commoner Liu Lu'er had three nipples and regarded it as a prodigy, plotting sedition;
s0216.idiomatic: In Zhending a commoner Liu Lu'er had three nipples, took it as a portent, and plotted sedition;

s0217.literal: When the matters were discovered, all were torn apart by dismemberment and displayed as warning.
s0217.idiomatic: When the plots were discovered, all were torn apart and displayed as warning.

s0218.literal: Five hundred garrison-farming troops of Wutiao River were moved to Ushiman and Zhashiman.
s0218.idiomatic: 500 Wutiao River garrison-farming troops were moved to Ushiman and Zhashiman.

s0219.literal: On xinmao day six thousand eight hundred guard troops were dispatched to supply the Huoguo Monastery renovation.
s0219.idiomatic: On xinmao day 6,800 guard troops were dispatched for Huoguo Monastery renovation.

s0220.literal: The Censorate confiscation and fine treasury was expanded.
s0220.idiomatic: The censorate confiscation and fine treasury was expanded.

s0221.literal: On guisi day Privy Council officials said: "Under the old system each of the four guard corps selected one man to participate in deciding Privy Council affairs; we ask that Teliebo be made vice administrator.
s0221.idiomatic: On guisi day privy council officials said, "Under the old system each of the four guard corps selected one man to participate in deciding privy council affairs; we ask that Teliebo be made vice administrator.

s0223.literal: An edict ordered vacant land in the capital surveyed and guard soldiers put to farming it.
s0223.idiomatic: An edict ordered vacant land in the capital surveyed and guard soldiers assigned to farm it.

s0224.literal: On yiwei day Central Secretariat officials asked that censor-in-chief Yusutemür be made left chief councillor and Central Secretariat associate Liman be made censor-in-chief.
s0224.idiomatic: On yiwei day central secretariat officials asked that censor-in-chief Yusutemür be made left chief councillor and secretariat associate Liman censor-in-chief.

s0225.literal: The Traveling Censorate was abolished; its subordinate surveillance commissions were placed under the Censorate; Traveling Censorate chief councillor Boruhan was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat.
s0225.idiomatic: The traveling censorate was abolished, its surveillance commissions placed under the censorate, and traveling censorate chief councillor Boruhan made associate administrator of the central secretariat.

s0226.literal: The Emperor said: "I must think about Yusutemür; Boruhan is lax and unsuitable.
s0226.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "I must think about Yusutemür; Boruhan is too lax and unsuitable.

s0228.literal: " The Emperor said: "I will handle this matter myself.
s0228.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "I will handle this matter myself.

s0229.literal: Abolishing the traveling censorate should proceed as submitted."
s0229.idiomatic: Abolishing the traveling censorate should proceed as submitted."

s0230.literal: Lu Shirong asked to abolish the Fujian Branch Secretariat, establish a pacification commission, and place it under the Jiangxi Branch Secretariat.
s0230.idiomatic: Lu Shirong asked to abolish the Fujian branch secretariat, establish a pacification commission, and place it under the Jiangxi branch secretariat.

s0231.literal: He also said: "The Jiangnan Branch Secretariat has too many affairs and may become congested; it would be convenient now to establish a traveling privy council alongside the branch secretariat to command troops and divide the work.
s0231.idiomatic: He also said, "The Jiangnan branch secretariat's business is heavy and may stall; it would be convenient to establish a traveling privy council alongside the branch secretariat to command troops and divide the work.

s0232.literal: " The Emperor said: "The matter of the traveling bureau was discussed the other day; it was stopped because Ahmad wished his son Husin to hold military authority as well; now the proposal is to be carried out."
s0232.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "The traveling bureau was discussed the other day; it was stopped because Ahmad wanted his son Husin to hold military power as well; now the proposal is to be carried out."

s0233.literal: Twenty-three generals who had returned from the Champa campaign without authorization were banished to distant places.
s0233.idiomatic: Twenty-three generals who had returned from the Champa campaign without authorization were banished to distant places.

s0234.literal: On bingshen day the Emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
s0234.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor hunted near the capital.

s0235.literal: The Directorate of Military Stores was promoted to the Bureau of Military Stores, the Directorate of Palace Physicians to the Grand Medical Service; both offices were rank three; the Six Ministries were raised to rank two.
s0235.idiomatic: The directorate of military stores was promoted to bureau of military stores, the directorate of palace physicians to the grand medical service—both rank three—and the six ministries were raised to rank two.

s0236.literal: Kebichige was made associate administrator of the Central Secretariat; the Ministry of Rites was ordered to oversee the Hall of Joint Audience.
s0236.idiomatic: Kebichige was made associate administrator of the central secretariat, and the Ministry of Rites was ordered to oversee the Hall of Joint Audience.

s0237.literal: At first when foreign envoys arrived they were usually handled by the Hanlin Academy; at this time this was corrected.
s0237.idiomatic: Formerly foreign envoys were usually handled by the Hanlin Academy; that arrangement was now changed.

s0238.literal: The Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat pacified one hundred sixty-six rebel Man cave communities.
s0238.idiomatic: The Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat pacified 166 rebel Man cave communities.

s0239.idiomatic: An edict prohibited private distillation of wine.

s0240.literal: On jihai day Nanchang, under the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat's jurisdiction, was placed under Jiangxi Province.
s0240.idiomatic: On jihai day Nanchang, under Jiangzhe branch secretariat jurisdiction, was placed under Jiangxi Province.

s0241.literal: On xinchou day Yang Uludai was made pacification commissioner for the Guwei campaign and granted a two-pearl tiger tally.
s0241.idiomatic: On xinchou day Yang Uludai was made pacification commissioner for the Guwei campaign and granted a two-pearl tiger tally.

s0242.literal: On renyin day a great wine vessel was made in the hall; the vessel was of wood with silver inside and gold outside, carved with cloud-dragons, one zhang and seven cun high.
s0242.idiomatic: On renyin day a great wine vessel was made for the hall—wooden, silver-lined and gold-clad, carved with cloud-dragons, one zhang and seven cun high.

s0243.literal: That month on renwu day Umar led troops and encountered Prince Xingdao of Annam; he defeated them, and the army halted north of the Fu River.
s0243.idiomatic: That month on renwu day Umar led troops and met Prince Xingdao of Annam, defeated them, and halted north of the Fu River.

s0244.literal: On yiyou day Annam heir Chen Rixuan led more than one thousand warships to resist.
s0244.idiomatic: On yiyou day Annam heir Chen Rixuan led more than 1,000 warships to resist.

s0245.literal: On bingxu day they joined battle and routed them; Rixuan fled and they entered his city.
s0245.idiomatic: On bingxu day they fought and routed them; Rixuan fled, and they entered the city.

s0246.literal: They returned to encamp north of the Fu River; Suodu, Tangudai, and others led troops to join the Prince of Zhennan.
s0246.idiomatic: They returned to encamp north of the Fu River; Suodu, Tangudai, and others led troops to join the Prince of Zhennan.

s0247.literal: Second month, on yisi day, the imperial carriage halted at Willow Grove.
s0247.idiomatic: In the second month, on yisi day, the imperial carriage halted at Willow Grove.

s0248.literal: Three thousand transport vessels of Jizhou were added; twelve thousand corvee laborers were assigned.
s0248.idiomatic: Jizhou's transport fleet was increased by 3,000 vessels, with 12,000 corvee laborers assigned.

s0249.literal: At first Huai-Jiang annually transported one million shi of grain to the capital by canal: one hundred thousand shi by sea, six hundred thousand shi via Jiao and Lai, and three hundred thousand shi via Ji; the water was shallow and the boats large, so they often could not reach destination; boats of one hundred shi were substituted, each boat using four men, hence corvee numbers increased.
s0249.idiomatic: At first Huai-Jiang annually transported 1 million shi of grain to the capital: 100,000 shi by sea, 600,000 via Jiao and Lai, and 300,000 via Ji; the water was too shallow for large boats, so 100-shi boats were substituted, each needing four men, and corvee numbers increased.

s0250.literal: A breach in the Hun River dike was closed; four thousand corvee laborers were employed.
s0250.idiomatic: A breach in the Hun River dike was closed with 4,000 corvee laborers.

s0251.literal: An edict changed the Huai-Jiang and Jiangxi marshal pacification commissions into upper, middle, and lower wanhu commands; Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were mixed together, forming thirty-seven wings.
s0251.idiomatic: An edict changed the Huai-Jiang and Jiangxi marshal pacification commissions into upper, middle, and lower wanhu commands; Mongol, Han, and newly submitted troops were combined in 37 wings.

s0252.literal: Upper wanhu: seven wings—Suzhou, Qixian, Zhending, Yitai, Yidu, Gaoyou, and Coastal;
s0252.idiomatic: Upper wanhu: seven wings—Suzhou, Qixian, Zhending, Yitai, Yidu, Gaoyou, and Coastal;

s0253.literal: Middle wanhu: eight wings—Zaoyang, Shizilu, Pizhou, Dengzhou, Hangzhou, Huaizhou, Mengzhou, and Zhenzhou;
s0253.idiomatic: Middle wanhu: eight wings—Zaoyang, Shizilu, Pizhou, Dengzhou, Hangzhou, Huaizhou, Mengzhou, and Zhenzhou;

s0254.literal: Lower wanhu: twenty-two wings—Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yingzhou, Luzhou, Bozhou, Anqing, Jiangyin Naval Force, Yidu New Army, Huzhou, Huai'an, Shouchun, Yangzhou, Taizhou, Crossbowmen, Baojia, Chuzhou, Shangdu New Army, Huangzhou, Anfeng, Songjiang, Zhenjiang Naval Force, and Jiankang.
s0254.idiomatic: Lower wanhu: 22 wings—Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Yingzhou, Luzhou, Bozhou, Anqing, Jiangyin Naval Force, Yidu New Army, Huzhou, Huai'an, Shouchun, Yangzhou, Taizhou, Crossbowmen, Baojia, Chuzhou, Shangdu New Army, Huangzhou, Anfeng, Songjiang, Zhenjiang Naval Force, and Jiankang.

s0255.literal: Each wing had one darughachi, one wanhu, and one vice wanhu, placed under the local traveling bureau.
s0255.idiomatic: Each wing had one darughachi, one wanhu, and one vice wanhu, placed under the local traveling bureau.

s0256.literal: The remaining followers of Jiangxi bandit Li De and others were all pacified.
s0256.idiomatic: The remaining followers of the Jiangxi bandit Li De were all pacified.

s0257.literal: Guard troops due for rotation leave from the five guards were used to excavate the Hexiwu River.
s0257.idiomatic: Guard troops from the five guards due for rotation leave were assigned to excavate the Hexiwu River.

s0258.literal: Under the old rule, of every ten guard soldiers, seven and three were divided into two shifts; in the tenth month the seven on leave returned and resumed service in the first month; those three on leave from the first month returned and resumed in the fourth month, alternating rest periods.
s0258.idiomatic: Under the old rule, every ten guard soldiers were divided into shifts of seven and three; those seven released in the tenth month returned to service in the first month, and those three released in the first month returned in the fourth month, alternating rest.

s0259.literal: On bingwu day the Eight Fan and Luodian under the Jinghu Branch Secretariat were placed under the West Sichuan Branch Secretariat; Lan and Guan were divided into two prefectures.
s0259.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Eight Fan and Luodian under the Jinghu branch secretariat were placed under the West Sichuan branch secretariat, and Lan and Guan were split into two prefectures.

s0260.literal: The Sanggan River god Lord Hongji was promoted to Lord Manifest Response Hongji.
s0260.idiomatic: The Sanggan River god Lord Hongji was promoted to Lord Manifest Response Hongji.

s0261.literal: On jiyou day a Bureau of Extended Blessings was established for the imperial grandson Anandapati, rank four; one commissioner, one vice commissioner, and one deputy commissioner.
s0261.idiomatic: On jiyou day a bureau of extended blessings was established for imperial grandson Anandapati, rank four, with one commissioner, vice commissioner, and deputy commissioner each.

s0262.literal: On xinhai day Guangdong pacification commissioner Yediemishi suppressed forty-five stockades of Chaozhou and Huizhou bandits including Guo Fenggui; all were pacified; more than ten thousand households and three thousand six hundred ten soldiers surrendered; he asked to bring the captured chieftains to court to report affairs in person; this was approved.
s0262.idiomatic: On xinhai day Guangdong pacification commissioner Yediemishi suppressed 45 stockades of Chaozhou and Huizhou bandits including Guo Fenggui; more than 10,000 households and 3,610 soldiers surrendered; he asked to bring captured chieftains to court to report in person, and this was approved.

s0263.literal: On bingchen day an edict abolished the new canal excavated at Jiao and Lai; ten thousand troops were assigned to the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat for naval training, and ten thousand men transported Huai-Jiang grain by sea via Lijin to the capital.
s0263.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict abolished the new canal at Jiao and Lai; 10,000 troops were assigned to the Jiangzhe branch secretariat for naval training, and 10,000 men transported Huai-Jiang grain by sea via Lijin to the capital.

s0264.literal: On xinyou day censorate officials said: "Recently the Central Secretariat memorialized to abolish the traveling censorate, change surveillance commissions into criminal-transport commissions, have them also manage revenue and grain, and thereby the function of investigation and impeachment is abandoned.
s0264.idiomatic: On xinyou day censorate officials said, "Recently the central secretariat memorialized to abolish the traveling censorate, change surveillance commissions into criminal-transport commissions with revenue and grain added, abandoning investigation and impeachment.

s0265.literal: Please have An Tong deliberate with senior ministers."
s0265.idiomatic: Please have An Tong deliberate with senior ministers."

s0267.literal: On renxu day the moon transited the Heart asterism.
s0267.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transited the Heart asterism.

s0268.literal: Central Secretariat official Lu Shirong asked to establish a planning bureau to manage revenue and grain, rank five; officials used should be skilled in trade, not limited to those without office rank; the Emperor approved.
s0268.idiomatic: Central secretariat official Lu Shirong asked to establish a planning bureau to manage revenue and grain, rank five, staffed by skilled traders without rank restrictions; the Emperor approved.

s0269.literal: Associate administrator Buluosimishihaiya and others then memorialized that among Lu Shirong's affinal kin was one surnamed Niu, formerly intendant; now the Zhexi transport commission's revenue was considerable and he was proposed for promotion to vice transport commissioner; this was also approved.
s0269.idiomatic: Associate administrator Buluosimishihaiya and others then memorialized that Lu Shirong's affinal kinsman Niu, formerly an intendant, was proposed as Zhexi transport vice commissioner given rising revenue; this was also approved.

s0270.literal: An edict ordered that residents of the old city moving to the capital should have priority by wealth and office-holding; a rule was also set that eight mu of land constituted one share;
s0270.idiomatic: An edict ordered that old-city residents moving to the capital be prioritized by wealth and office, with eight mu of land set as one share;

s0271.literal: If land exceeded eight mu or one lacked strength to build a dwelling, none might falsely claim it; commoners were allowed to build dwellings.
s0271.idiomatic: Anyone holding more than eight mu or unable to build a dwelling could not falsely claim land; commoners were allowed to build.

s0272.literal: The Imperial Belt Store was promoted to the Bureau of Insignia and Girdle Pendants.
s0272.idiomatic: The imperial belt store was promoted to the bureau of insignia and girdle pendants.

s0273.literal: Right chiliarch Zhierhaimishi's apportioned land was moved to Quanzhou.
s0273.idiomatic: The apportioned land of right chiliarch Zhierhaimishi was moved to Quanzhou.

s0274.literal: Five thousand newly submitted households were granted to Qaljasudar; Qalchi, Asud, Atachi, Sibachi, Guichid, and others who had once gone on campaign were also all granted households.
s0274.idiomatic: 5,000 newly submitted households were granted to Qaljasudar; Qalchi, Asud, Atachi, Sibachi, Guichid, and others who had campaigned were also granted households.

s0275.literal: Eighty households were granted to crown prince guard officers who had once gone on campaign.
s0275.idiomatic: 80 households were granted to crown prince guard officers who had campaigned.

s0276.literal: Following Lu Shirong's proposal, Jiangnan commoners' land was purchased back by the state.
s0276.idiomatic: Following Lu Shirong's proposal, Jiangnan commoners' land was bought back by the state.

s0277.literal: An edict ordered copper cash confiscated empire-wide.
s0277.idiomatic: An edict ordered copper cash confiscated throughout the realm.

s0278.literal: Private manufacture of brewing malt was again prohibited.
s0278.idiomatic: Private manufacture of brewing malt was again prohibited.

s0279.literal: On wuchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0279.idiomatic: On wuchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0280.literal: The Emperor asked secretariat officials: "Why was the traveling censorate abolished?
s0280.idiomatic: The Emperor asked secretariat officials, "Why was the traveling censorate abolished?

s0281.literal: " An Tong said: "Bandits have repeatedly risen in Jiangnan; the traveling censorate has chiefly checked them; I hold it should not be abolished.
s0281.idiomatic: " An Tong said, "Bandits have repeatedly risen in Jiangnan; the traveling censorate has chiefly checked them; I hold it should not be abolished.

s0282.literal: Yet it is together with the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat in Hangzhou, a very remote place; moving it to Jiangzhou, centered among Jiangzhe, Hunan, and Jiangxi provinces, would be convenient."
s0282.idiomatic: Yet it sits together with the Jiangzhe branch secretariat in Hangzhou, a very remote spot; moving it to Jiangzhou, centered among Jiangzhe, Hunan, and Jiangxi, would be convenient."

s0284.literal: Pacification commissions also serving as general transport commissions were established at Zhending, Jinan, Taiyuan, Gansu, Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, Huguang, and other places to administer revenue; regulations were also established.
s0284.idiomatic: Pacification commissions also serving as general transport commissions were established at Zhending, Jinan, Taiyuan, Gansu, Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, Huguang, and other places to administer revenue, and regulations were also established.

s0285.literal: All offices were forbidden to summon revenue officials without authorization; anyone who dared obstruct was to report names.
s0285.idiomatic: All offices were forbidden to summon revenue officials without authorization; anyone who obstructed was to report names.

s0286.literal: The Jizhou grain transport commission's soldiers were increased by twelve thousand.
s0286.idiomatic: Jizhou grain transport commission troops were increased by 12,000.

s0287.literal: Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, and Huguang shipbuilding intendant commissions were established.
s0287.idiomatic: Jiangxi, Huai-Jiang, and Huguang shipbuilding intendant commissions were established.

s0288.literal: Feng Gui, Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat associate administrator; Huguang Branch Secretariat right associate Yaosumu and associate Pan Jie; Longxing Branch Secretariat left associate Bayan, associate Yang Jukuan, and secretariat secretary Chen Wenfu were ordered to oversee revenue affairs exclusively.
s0288.idiomatic: Feng Gui of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat, Huguang right associate Yaosumu and associate Pan Jie, and Longxing left associate Bayan, associate Yang Jukuan, and secretariat secretary Chen Wenfu were ordered to oversee revenue exclusively.

s0289.literal: Önggiradai was made left chief councillor of the Central Secretariat.
s0289.idiomatic: Önggiradai was made left chief councillor of the central secretariat.

s0290.literal: On jisi day surveillance commissions were reestablished.
s0290.idiomatic: On jisi day surveillance commissions were reestablished.

s0291.literal: Twenty-seven thousand households were assigned to imperial son-in-law Suolangge.
s0291.idiomatic: 27,000 households were assigned to imperial son-in-law Suolangge.

s0293.literal: An edict stated: "For each circuit's criminal-surveillance commission, those who can observe regulations and succeed in their duties shall be promoted when terms expire; those corrupt and unfit shall be dismissed and stricken from the rolls.
s0293.idiomatic: An edict stated, "On each circuit's criminal-surveillance commission, those who observe regulations and succeed shall be promoted at term's end; the corrupt and unfit shall be dismissed and stricken from the rolls.

s0294.literal: " An edict also established the Provision Bureau, rank five, with one darughachi, one director, and one vice director each.
s0294.idiomatic: " An edict also established the provision bureau, rank five, with one darughachi, director, and vice director each.

s0295.literal: Rongzhou general administration prefecture was reduced to a prefecture.
s0295.idiomatic: Rongzhou general administration prefecture was reduced to a prefecture.

s0296.literal: Third month, on bingzi day, Astronomical Bureau observers Zhang Gongli, Peng Zhi, and others were dispatched to Champa to observe the sundial.
s0296.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi day, astronomical bureau observers Zhang Gongli, Peng Zhi, and others were sent to Champa to observe the sundial.

s0297.literal: On guiwei day the Ganzhou Branch Secretariat was abolished, a pacification commission established, and placed under the Ningxia Branch Secretariat.
s0297.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Ganzhou branch secretariat was abolished, a pacification commission established, and placed under the Ningxia branch secretariat.

s0298.literal: The Jinghu-Champa Branch Secretariat requested additional troops; at this time forces that Chen Rixuan had fled from at Tianchang and Chang'an had reassembled; Prince Xingdao's thousand-plus ships gathered at Wanji; Ruan'an was at Yongping; government troops had marched far and fought long, isolated in their midst; Suodu's and Tangudai's troops also did not arrive on schedule; hence additional troops were requested.
s0298.idiomatic: The Jinghu-Champa branch secretariat requested reinforcements: Chen Rixuan's forces at Tianchang and Chang'an had regrouped, Prince Xingdao had more than 1,000 ships at Wanji, and Ruan'an held Yongping, while government troops fighting far from base were isolated and Suodu's and Tangudai's forces had not arrived on time.

s0299.literal: The Emperor regarded travel by water as dangerous and ordered proceeding by land.
s0299.idiomatic: The Emperor regarded travel by water as dangerous and ordered troops to proceed by land.

s0300.literal: On gengzi day an edict followed the old system: each salt certificate was four hundred jin, priced at ten liang of silver, converted at the present rate to twenty guan of notes; merchants going to Shangdu paid one-sixtieth in tax.
s0300.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict restored the old system: each salt certificate was 400 jin, priced at ten liang of silver or twenty guan of notes at current rates; merchants going to Shangdu paid tax at one-sixtieth.
